title: Payments & refunds
intro: Review your payment attempts and any recorded refunds. Open a booking for its latest payment details.
attemptNote: A payment attempt is not proof of a charge. Check its status below; this page does not start or repeat a payment.
emptyNote: Payment attempts will appear here when you start payment for a booking.
endNote: Return to the first page to review your most recent activity.
timeZone: All dates and times are shown in Cairo time.
